findings.fix: Split the `SelfDuality`/existing Cartier-equivalence refactor from the two new `CartierDuality/BaseChange.lean` modules and their supporting scheme API.

summary: The PR combines two independently useful topics: rebuilding the existing anti-equivalence and adding new base-change theory. These must be split.
